# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** Seven years old  <sub>[v2 c22 P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy is a handsome little lad with a round head covered in fuzzy yellow ringlets and roguish, dancing hazel eyes. He has a snub nose and a smiling mouth with a dimple in one cheek, giving him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033)_

## Personality

Davy is full of mischief, heedless, and disobedient, but he possesses a born knack for winning love. He has an intense, lively curiosity and constantly asks questions that confuse or shock others. Lacking imagination, he is very practical, energetic, and prone to overzealousness in his endeavors. Despite his trouble-making tendencies, he is easily comforted by food.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031), [v2 c18 P3](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0003), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c25 P41](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0041)_

## History

Davy Keith grew up without much proper upbringing because his father died when he was a baby and his mother was sick for most of his early life. After his mother passed away, Davy and his twin sister Dora were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert at Green Gables. Shortly after his arrival, Davy grew devoted to Anne Shirley and strove to wash his face regularly to win her approval over Paul Irving. He frequently got into trouble due to his boundless curiosity and mischievous nature, such as hanging over the well to find where the dark went or being sent upstairs by Marilla for disobedience. Davy began attending school alongside his sister, sharing a desk with Milty Boulter and frequently making terrible faces at Paul Irving. He also spent time helping Mr. Harrison haul dulse and assisting John Henry Carter in executing two white roosters. Over time, under Anne's gentle guidance, Davy's behavior reformed significantly.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P33](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0033), [v2 c9 P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 c16 P32](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0032), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031), [v2 c19 P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020), [v2 c20 P8](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0008), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c26 P31](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0031)_
